record.body:
Reviewed task519 at `31b836e1`, excluding the four accepted505 prerequisite commits.

The change in `crates/xterm-addons/src/ligatures/font_cff2_dict.rs` preserves the required ordering: global INDEX validation, complete dictionary lexing, duplicate decisions, then the missing-FDArray guard. Its truthiness handling matches the source for absent values, zero, negative zero, NaN, arrays, and nonzero values. CFF1 and later FDArray traversal remain unchanged.

Verification performed:
- Cached audit passed: 26 producer pins, 776 reference hashes in each of two roots, retained WASM compiler hash, and cached executable pins.
- Source oracle replay passed all 860 cases. Report writes were disabled in memory to keep the review read-only.
- Pinned native integration tests passed 2/2; dictionary unit tests passed 5/5 using the corrected `index::dict::tests` filter.
- All 18 generated runtime file hashes verified.
- Inspected retained Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit source/WASM results and actual addon-loading assertions.
- Contribution whitespace check passed. No files changed.

The eight presence-only controls are correctly distinguished from the 852 complete constructor comparisons. Full FDArray support, overall equivalence, full-workspace format success, and Linux/macOS runtime coverage are not claimed.

VERDICT: accept

Concrete problems: none.

postReviewChanges: Documentation/results-only tail. Correct cached unit command filter to index::dict::tests, as independently executed5/5. No producer Rust/test changes.
